issues.description: Class/name inconsistency: The problem statement (and the solution) describe and use a class named 'Meal' with constructor Meal(String, String[]) and getters, but the template repository does not include an implementation of Meal (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java is empty). Instead the template contains an 'Order' class with the same fields and API. This mismatch (Meal vs Order and missing Meal.java in the template) will confuse students and can cause compilation errors because exercises, examples, and the solution expect the type to be named 'Meal'.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the class name consistent across all artifacts. Either add a Meal.java to the template matching the solution's Meal (constructor Meal(String, String[]) and getters) and remove or rename Order.java, or rename the template's Order.java to Meal.java and update any references (e.g., in Main and the problem statement) so that the template, problem statement, and solution all use the same class name 'Meal'. Ensure examples and tests reference the unified name.
